segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on your account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, it’s Northstar Fabrication, and the email is daniel.cho@northstarfab.com. I’m just looking for a copy of our February invoice, if that’s something you can send over.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. For verification, can you confirm the last four digits of the payment method on file?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect. I’m in the billing tool now. I see invoice 78241 for February 1 through February 29, total was $1,860 for 62 seats. Is that the one you need?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That sounds right. Our controller asked for the PDF before noon, so if you can email it to me that’d be great.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem. I’m sending it to daniel.cho@northstarfab.com now, and I’ll include the billing contact we have on file, marisa.lee@northstarfab.com. Okay to copy her?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. You should have the email in a minute or two. The subject line will include invoice 78241, and I also added the payment receipt as a second attachment.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it, it just came through. Both attachments are there. Thanks, that’s all I needed.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Glad to help. I’ll close out ticket 146233 as resolved. Have a good one.
